verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a cloud file-conversion service. The evidence only shows an API, a CLI, wrappers and one-off drag-and-drop conversions; nothing documents scheduled, recurring or workflow automation. An API or CLI that a user could drive from an external scheduler is a developer building block, not the product's own scheduling capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
